x: Place it so the juice spout hangs over a barrel one block to that side, not on top of the barrel. Driven by a small wooden gear (shaft toward your power network). Pack juiceable fruit, berries, vegetables, or honeycomb into the open top basin by hand, or feed them from the copper hopper face / from above with a chute. Powered juicing sends juice out the spout into that unsealed barrel and the fruit pile shrinks as juice leaves. Dried mash can be pulled out by a chute directly underneath as juice is pressed, which frees room for more fruit. Empty-handed right click takes the mash out. Holds up to 50 litres. A straight or elbow chute on top of the basin feeds fruit in. If the player who placed the juicer has the xSkills Juicer ability unlocked, fruit added by hand or by chute yields that extra juice, including while the machine runs on its own.
